description: Admin commission management and independent doctor registration: Admin UI to set commission rates per center; independent doctor signup page for doctors without centers; center admin UI for provisioning doctors
steps: 1. app/api/admin/centers/commission/route.ts already exists - verify it accepts PUT with {centerId, commissionType, commissionRate?, fixedCommissionAmount?}, validates PERCENTAGE has rate 0-100, FIXED has positive amount, updates centers table, sends email notification to center admin about commission change

2. Create lib/validations/doctor.ts with Zod schemas: provisionDoctorSchema (name, email, phone?, category, specialization?, licenseNumber, price, consultationFee?, bio?, imageUrl?), checkInSchema (bookingId UUID), checkOutSchema (bookingId UUID, actualPrice?), commissionSchema (centerId UUID, commissionType enum, commissionRate?, fixedCommissionAmount? with refinement)

3. Apply validation schemas to all relevant API routes: provision route uses provisionDoctorSchema.safeParse(), checkin routes use checkInSchema, checkout uses checkOutSchema, commission route uses commissionSchema

4. Create app/api/doctors/register/route.ts (no auth required): validate email uniqueness, validate licenseNumber uniqueness in doctors table, create user (role=DOCTOR, emailVerified=false, passwordResetRequired=true), create account via Better Auth (hash password), create doctor record (centerId=null, isIndependent=true, active=false, provisioned=false), send verification email, notify admins via email or notification about new independent doctor pending approval, return {doctor: {id, name, email}, message}

5. Create app/signup/doctor/page.tsx: public signup form with fields (personal: name, email, password, phone; professional: category dropdown, specialization, licenseNumber; pricing: consultationFee, price; bio optional), validate with provisionDoctorSchema client-side, POST to /api/doctors/register, redirect to /auth/verify-email-sent on success

6. Find or create center doctors management page (likely app/center/doctors/page.tsx): add ProvisionDoctorModal component with form fields matching provisionDoctorSchema, on submit POST to /api/center/doctors/provision, display temp password once with copy button and security warning, on success refresh doctors list

7. Find or create admin center detail page (app/admin/centers/[id]/page.tsx): add commission settings section with radio buttons (PERCENTAGE or FIXED), conditional number inputs (commissionRate 0-100 for PERCENTAGE, fixedCommissionAmount for FIXED), on submit POST to /api/admin/centers/commission with centerId and commission data, display success message

8. Create mobile/lib/features/doctor/screens/change_password_screen.dart: form with oldPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword fields, on submit POST to /api/auth/change-password-first-login with Bearer token, on success navigate to DoctorDashboard (no back button allowed), show password strength indicator
9. Update mobile auth flow to check passwordResetRequired in login response, if true navigate to ChangePasswordScreen before allowing access to other screens

10. Add device tracking to mobile: create getDeviceId() using device_info_plus (androidInfo.androidId for Android, iosInfo.identifierForVendor for iOS), add X-Device-ID and X-Device-Name headers to all authenticated mobile API calls, handle device verification OTP flow in mobile UI if API returns requiresDeviceVerification flag
acceptance_criteria: Admin can update center commission settings via admin dashboard, center receives email notification
Independent doctor can sign up via public /signup/doctor page without center affiliation
Independent doctor account created with active=false, requires admin approval
Admin notified of new independent doctor registration
Center admin can provision doctors via center dashboard, receives temp password once
All API routes use Zod validation schemas for input validation
Mobile app enforces password reset on first login before allowing dashboard access
Mobile app sends device ID in headers for device tracking
Validation errors return 400 with detailed field-level errors
verification: Login as ADMIN, navigate to center detail page, change commission settings (try PERCENTAGE and FIXED), verify PUT to /api/admin/centers/commission succeeds
Check centers table to confirm commissionType and rate/amount updated
Check center admin's email or notifications for commission change notice
Visit /signup/doctor (logged out), fill form with unique email and license, submit, verify 200 response and user/doctor created in database with isIndependent=true and active=false
Check admin notifications or email for new doctor registration alert
Login as CENTER, navigate to doctors page, click Add Doctor, fill provision form, submit, verify temp password displayed once and doctor created with provisioned=true
Test mobile password reset: simulate first login by setting passwordResetRequired=true for test doctor, login via mobile, verify navigation to change password screen with no escape
Test mobile device headers: Add console logging to trackDevice(), make mobile API call, verify X-Device-ID header received and device record created
